trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: She was waiting for an hour when it arrived.
trap.right: She had been waiting for an hour when it arrived.
trap.why: Português usa o imperfeito. Para espera que durou até um evento passado: had been + -ing.

mcq.q: She **___** for an hour when the announcement came.

fix.wrong: She had wait for an hour.
fix.right: She had been waiting for an hour.

fix.wrong: She had been waiting when I will arrive.
fix.right: She had been waiting when I arrived.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “She waited for an hour. The announcement came.” (had been)
rewrite.answer: She had been waiting for an hour when the announcement came.
